persona_tomas.md: Past thirty, a programmer who grew up in the free country and works for a firm abroad without ever having to leave it. Every one of those facts is later than the last plot this play stages, which is the Velvet Revolution of 1989; he was born into what it produced. Casting him in it would put the result inside its own cause. He is held by the culture-position and the language position and answers to the pitch.
